Any proposed architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, semantic-testbench-contract, or exact board-source change. None is authorized by this repair decision, and immutable comparison artifacts may not be loosened within this repair loop.

observations: The direct current real-tool failure is case_axi_ddr_interface. Its checker reports an unbound simulation source-identity hash, unbound exact Vivado-export compile authority and command authority references, and simulator commands not authorized by the current tool_profile or referenced export.

The functional-simulation precondition also lacks the required exact_sample_top_module loading evidence. The current case_vcs_functional_sim invocation was dependency-skipped, so functional_sim=fail is not executed evidence of an RTL value, numeric, AXI, DDR, ordering, liveness, or output-frontier defect.

case_board_interface_discovery and case_multilayer_pipeline currently pass. The bounded repair must consume their discovered exact project facts rather than rediscovering or guessing a substitute wrapper, top module, executable, or compile order.

The supplied VCS diagnosis is historical_only because a live source hash changed and its diagnosis binding does not match the current failed gate. It may not authorize a source repair or hardware root-cause claim.

Prior repair feedback recorded a nonterminal board trace and requested raw simulator termination evidence plus runner wall-time and cycle-budget provenance. That record remains a useful failure lesson, but it is not current pass evidence and does not override the current dependency-skipped result.
The operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates are live and hash-validated. No current trace contradicts them, so neither layer may be reopened or replayed.

The connected kernel is certified as an elastic variable-latency token pipeline. Future board traces must check required boundary order and cross-token overlap, not require unequal-latency stages to start or finish on the same cycle.

Independent AXI or prefetch progress is not output or lifecycle-frontier progress. A future frontier stall can guide observation but cannot by itself select an RTL root cause or reopen the connected kernel.

sacg_memory_truth is authoritative and reports 15 active contamination barriers, six open retry requests, and zero open backtrack requests for this scope. The contaminated Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only until successful checker-driven reconciliation.
The conditional design-team review was no_split and supplied no specialist pass evidence or alternative repair authority.
proposed_actions: Rebind only the checker-facing board simulation identity, compile-authority, executable-authorization, and top-module loading manifests to the already discovered exact project and immutable source hashes.
Rerun case_axi_ddr_interface as the first targeted failed checker; do not run VCS or modify RTL until it passes.
Implement or adopt an approved remote-VCS termination provenance capability that records raw termination, runner wall-time, cycle budget, and replay authorization.
Run an unchanged, hash-bound current-layer VCS targeted replay with board boundary, lifecycle/output-frontier, AXI/DDR, transfer-count, weight-consumption, and deadlock monitoring.
If the replay fails, generate a current-applicable CCTG causal slice before any source repair; reopen a lower layer only if the strict current-trace contradiction requirements are met.
If the replay passes, execute the remaining board-layer gate DAG and assemble real-weight semantic evidence using the immutable target-model golden and numeric policy.
After every board-layer checker passes, reconcile all current-scope retry requests and contamination barriers through SACG checkers; otherwise keep them active and return to Stage8.
risks: Changing the exact user-supplied wrapper or sample-project source hashes, substituting a simplified AXI/DDR wrapper, or guessing a top module or Vivado context would invalidate board-level evidence.
Editing the generated semantic testbench contract, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, tolerance, or numeric policy to obtain a pass would contaminate the repair loop.

A fresh VCS execution that ends without a terminal event could be an external runner-budget termination rather than a design liveness failure; without raw termination and configured-budget evidence, an RTL patch would be unjustified.
Existing nonterminal or historical traces are source-stale relative to the current identity failure and cannot challenge lower-layer certificates.
A board output-frontier symptom without current direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate-binding evidence could incorrectly reopen a certified connected kernel.

Board semantic evidence can still fail after liveness if data order, transfer counts, DDR address mapping, complete Transformer-block weight consumption, or same-input target-model numeric comparison is not proven.
Embedding, tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, or sampling could accidentally be added to the DUT golden or weight requirements unless the Transformer-block-only scope is enforced.

The active SACG barriers and retries continue to block downstream use even if an individual repaired artifact is generated; only complete current-stage checks and explicit SACG reconciliation can remove that contamination status.

constraints: no lower-layer reopening without a current hash-bound named contradiction
immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, testbench contract, and exact board source hashes
expected outputs must come from the real target model
complete Transformer-block tensor consumption must be executed and hash-bound
embedding, tokenization, final model norm, LM head, logits, and sampling remain outside DUT scope
edges: exact Vivado export facts and current tool_profile -> canonical VCS compile plan and executable authorization
immutable exact board sources -> board testbench artifact-loading manifest
immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model output, numeric policy, and Transformer-block weight binding -> board functional comparison
current hash-bound board replay -> current boundary trace -> CCTG failure localization
validated lower-layer certificates -> reusable board-layer inputs unless a current named contradiction is proven
complete board-layer gate pass -> SACG retry and contamination-barrier reconciliation -> possible backend promotion

output.summary: Fail closed at board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system. The only presently justified repair is to the current board-verification harness bindings: bind the live exact sample-project identity, exact Vivado-export compile authority, authorized simulator executable, and exact_sample_top_module loading evidence without changing the immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, semantic testbench contract, or exact board sources. No RTL root candidate exists because the current VCS run was dependency-skipped. After the interface gate passes, execute a hash-bound current-layer targeted replay with boundary and termination provenance. Preserve certified operator-leaf and connected-kernel evidence unless that new trace explicitly contradicts a named invariant. Backend promotion remains blocked by all 15 active contamination barriers and six open retry requests until the complete board-layer gate DAG passes and SACG reconciliation is checker-accepted.
